name: Intrinsic Crafter
body:
Your inner magic lends itself to crafting enchanted objects.

Prerequisite(s): Spell-like ability.

Benefit(s): The caster level for your spell-like abilities may be used to meet the caster level prerequisite for item creation feats.

Additionally, you can use your spell-like abilities to meet the spell prerequisites when crafting spell completion items, spell trigger items, and potions.

However, unlike when using your spell-like abilities normally, this requires that you supply any expensive (1 gp or more) material components or foci.

Special: This feat may also be used with druidic herbalism and other abilities that function like item creation feats.
